estimates.outcome: Expert-rated creativity of the participant's ideas (overall novelty and usefulness), both task complexities pooled
estimates.question: with_ai
estimates.measure_detail: Two trained independent external experts, blind to participant demographics, hypotheses and experimental design, rated each idea on overall novelty and usefulness using a five-point scale from extremely low to extremely high. Their average was used as the overall creativity score for each participant's ideas (PDF p. 5, Measurements).

estimates.control_arm: Human partner, simple task and Human partner, complex task (combined)

estimates.notes: This is the expert-rated output outcome despite its position under the Self-reported creativity heading. The paper lists human before LLM; the negative t and d retain that human-minus-LLM orientation, opposite to this record’s treatment/control order. No sign has been reversed and no mean difference computed. The confidence interval is printed beside these results without an identified estimand; it does not contain the printed d. Retain ci_of=null and do not assign these bounds to paper_effect or to a raw difference. The standardizer for d is unspecified. The one-way and factorial partner main-effect ANOVAs are alternate analyses of the same full-sample outcome and contrast, documented in resolutions and not_extracted rather than separate estimates. Arm counts and explicit standard errors are absent from the saved article. Task-specific simple effects are moderation results excluded by rule 5. Supplement update: the pooled participant counts are now transcribed from the demographic-table note, with a source quote above. The individual task-cell counts and explicit standard errors for this original pooled test remain unreported. The supplement does not identify this confidence interval or the standardizer for d. The mediator-adjusted direct regression is recorded separately as s1_creativity_llm_vs_human_pooled_direct_adjusted; its coefficient and standard error are not statistics for this t-test.

The proposed constrained-responsive configuration is treatment and batch-responsive is control. The schema’s eta2 type contains the paper’s partial eta squared. F and partial eta squared are unsigned; no pooled arm means or signed coefficient is printed, so the direction is unknown. No pooled SDs, arm counts, standard errors or confidence interval for a signed contrast are printed. Task-specific means and dispersions are not averaged or substituted into this record. Task-specific simple effects are moderation results excluded by rule 5. Supplement update: the pooled participant counts are now transcribed from the demographic-table note, with a source quote above. The other missing pooled descriptives and uncertainty for this original factorial contrast remain unreported. The mediator-adjusted direct regression is recorded separately as s2_creativity_constrained_vs_batch_pooled_direct_adjusted; it does not supply a signed total effect for this ANOVA.

open_items: Randomized and analyzed counts for the individual task-by-treatment cells remain unreported. Supplement 41599_2025_5867_MOESM1_ESM.pdf, PDF p. 10 (printed p. 9), Table S5, and PDF p. 11, Table S6, state only the pooled treatment/comparison group counts, now sourced in the estimates. Cell counts are not inferred from those totals, demographic probabilities, degrees of freedom or equal-allocation assumptions.

The estimand of the confidence interval accompanying the pooled expert-creativity comparison in S1 is not identified. Its bounds do not contain the printed d. ci_of remains null, and the bounds are not used as an interval for d. The standardizer for the printed d is also unspecified (PDF p. 5).

S2 still has no printed pooled arm means, pooled participant SDs, signed total-effect contrast, or explicit uncertainty for a signed total effect; the factorial F statistic and partial eta squared do not establish its direction (main PDF p. 6). The pooled arm counts are now settled by Supplement 41599_2025_5867_MOESM1_ESM.pdf, PDF p. 11, Table S6. Its Table S8 on PDF p. 12 supplies a mediator-adjusted direct coefficient and SE, recorded separately, which do not settle the missing total-effect direction or descriptives.

Overlap between participants in S1 and S2 is unknown. The paper does not say that recruitment was separate or that prior participants were excluded. No combined unique-person total is inferred. The screening sample_overlap field names no other paper sharing this sample (PDF pp. 4-5).

ERNIE Bot version and release year are not stated; ai_tool.year is null. Participant country and recruitment channel are not stated. The Chinese-language context described in the Discussion does not confirm the country of recruitment (PDF pp. 3-5 and 8).

The excluded conditional creativity analyses have unresolved dispersion labels and possible decimal errors; figure captions label the error bars as standard errors while the text labels the cell dispersions as SDs. S1 also has an inconsistent complex-task test. These numbers have not been corrected or substituted into pooled outcomes (PDF pp. 5-7).

The excluded S2 fixation moderated-mediation index still has a sign/description conflict and repeats the S1 index. The reference ideas used to score fixation in the human-partner arms also remain unclear. The supplement does not resolve either issue.

Supplement 41599_2025_5867_MOESM1_ESM.pdf, PDF p. 12 (unnumbered), Tables S7-S8, Model 4, labels the coefficients beta without identifying whether the regression outcome is raw or standardized. The new regression outcome_scale fields remain null. The supplement gives experiment-group counts but no model-specific total count, exact treatment p-values or treatment confidence intervals for these direct-effect equations.
notes: Reconciled on 2026-10-09. The entire markdown conversion was read in contiguous chunks through references and end matter; all ten PDF pages were read using PyMuPDF text extraction. Mathematical statistics on PDF pp. 5-6 were also checked in rendered, in-memory crops, without creating image files. PDF and printed page numbers coincide. Quoted subscripts/superscripts are linearized, ligatures and line wrapping normalized, and mathematical signs retained. Every numerical estimate field is linked once to a short source quote. No effects, counts, dispersion measures, signs or interval estimands were calculated or guessed. All comparison-script differences and both B-only records are resolved. There are two unique full-sample outcome/contrast/sample estimates, as defined by codebook section 2. B’s extra S1 ANOVA rows repeat an existing contrast; their statistics are preserved in resolution quotes and the analyses are listed in not_extracted. Both retained slugs follow A’s names. Every screened outcome and contrast is represented or explicitly excluded; no additional eligible full-sample estimate was found in the saved article. Task complexity is the paper’s moderator, so conditional creativity and fixation results are excluded under rules 4-5. Expert-rated fixation compares a participant’s output to existing LLM ideas, not different participants’ outputs. No across_people or after_ai outcome is reported. Counts, question, construct, unit, higher_is, AI availability and within_person were independently checked despite extractor agreement and are documented in resolutions. Each reported recruitment total is the cohort described as randomized; analyzed totals are separately printed in figure captions. No attrition is stated. The broad idea_generation task code covers the pooled alternate-uses and product-feature tasks. The online_panel code follows the screening form for paid online participants; the paper does not name a recruitment panel or participant country. No preregistration is stated. shared_sample remains null because the screening form names no other paper; overlap between the two experiments is unknown, and no combined unique-person count is asserted. Only the specified reconciled extraction JSON was written. Supplement update: the supplied markdown conversion was read in full, and every page of 41599_2025_5867_MOESM1_ESM.pdf was read with PyMuPDF; demographic notes and the regression tables were checked against PDF text and table cells, with the interface examples and regression-table page also inspected as in-memory images. The prior statements about an unchecked external supplement are superseded. Pooled arm counts have been added to the existing estimates; individual task-cell counts remain unknown. The supplement contains no additional experiment, replication, preregistration, pooled fluency result or across-person/delayed output outcome. It does print the full-sample direct assigned-condition coefficients from the mediator-adjusted creativity equations; these are now separate estimates, and the previous direct-path exclusions are updated accordingly. Conditional treatment terms from interaction models, indirect effects, self-reports, demographic proportions and stimulus idea pools remain excluded. All original estimate statistics, study records and historical reconciliation/verification records are preserved. The historical two-record coverage statement above refers to the main-only extraction. Supplement 41599_2025_5867_MOESM1_ESM.pdf, PDF pp. 13-14 (printed pp. 12-13), Section 5, resolves chat availability in both experiments: "You can greet and chat with your partner in the chat box." This establishes that participants could type chat messages; it does not establish additional LLM-generated answers beyond the scripted feed. The supplement_changes list logs numeric field additions to the pre-existing estimates; supplement_added lists the separately sourced new analyses. No statistics or cell counts were calculated, and no original main-text number was corrected.

review_corrections.basis: Direct effect from the moderated parallel mediation model (Supplement 41599_2025_5867_MOESM1_ESM.pdf, PDF p. 12): creativity regressed on the assigned condition together with creativity fixation and inspiration stimulation, which are measured after treatment. Adjusting for post-treatment mediators removes the randomized contrast, so this is not an estimate of the AI effect (extraction file, rule 5, as clarified on 2026-10-10). The total-effect records of the same contrasts remain.
